entries.list.statement: SELECT id, body, mood, created_at FROM entries WHERE user_id = ?1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200

entries.create.statement: INSERT INTO entries(user_id, body, mood, created_at) VALUES(?1, ?2, ?3, ?4)

entries.delete.guard: This entry is already deleted, or it is not yours.
entries.delete.statement: DELETE FROM entries WHERE id = ?1 AND user_id = ?2
